name: Turnaround Restructuring Thesis
axiom: Stabilise cash first; strategy is a luxury the balance sheet buys you.
trigger: Turnaround memos and distressed unit reviews, where the audience is deciding how much time exists.

steps.text: Deterioration: how the unit reached its current position.
Triage: what stops the cash bleed this quarter.
Realignment: the assets and lines that no longer fit.
Lean operation: the cost base the new shape can carry.

antiPattern.violation: Opening with a new strategy while the cash runway is under a quarter, which the board reads as denial.
antiPattern.remediation: Sequence triage before strategy. Name the week the bleeding stops, then the plan that follows.
